question: Should OpenClaw core accept gateway-owned model-proposed follow-up task suggestions with `spawn_task`/`dismiss_task`, Control UI accept/dismiss cards, and admin-gated managed-worktree session creation from suggested cwd?
rationale: This adds a new core model-tool and Gateway protocol/product surface rather than repairing an existing bug, and automation cannot decide whether the product/API boundary should become part of core.

options.title: Accept the PR shape after current-head validation
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical implementation if maintainers are comfortable with the new tool/API surface, admin cwd requirement, and progress-delivery contract change.

options.title: Narrow the API before merge
options.body: Keep the feature direction but ask for a smaller protocol/tool surface or a separate design pass before landing the UI and worktree lifecycle together.

options.title: Reject core scope
options.body: Close the PR and linked issue if follow-up suggestions should remain prose, subagents, or an external/plugin-owned workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept the PR shape after current-head validation
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical implementation if maintainers are comfortable with the new tool/API surface, admin cwd requirement, and progress-delivery contract change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the issue and PR and have the strongest recent managed-worktree/session ownership signal.
